$comment: Tier B — Product cards. Medium-volatility. Source of truth for product metadata, freshness, and evidence links. Generated views are built from this + evidence packets.

products.name: BMAD
products.rationale: Spec-first agent harness for turning vague goals into disciplined execution. Enforces planning, checkpointing, and quality gates before implementation begins.

conceptMappings.why: Strongest spec-first harness for turning vague goals into disciplined execution.
Best spec-first implementation loop when requirements discipline matters most.

products.name: GSD
products.rationale: Context-lifecycle harness with explicit checkpoints, budget control, and resume semantics. Best for durable multi-step agent execution.

conceptMappings.why: Best context-lifecycle harness with checkpoints, budget control, and resume semantics.
Best explicit checkpoint/resume model for recovering work without losing context.

products.name: LangGraph
products.rationale: Graph-based agent orchestration framework. Defines agent workflows as cyclic graphs with state management and tool execution.

conceptMappings.why: Most explicit graph-based control loop for stateful agent execution.
Features built-in central state persistence for branching, time travel, and durable execution.
